name: Sample research notes
tagline: A synthetic research notebook: briefs, news digests, and insight logs.

theme.label: Theme
theme.hint: Which of the notebook's four themes an item belongs to.
theme.question: Which theme is {item} mainly about?

options.edge-ai: Running models on small, local, or battery-powered hardware instead of the cloud.
options.developer-experience: How developers learn and use APIs, SDKs, docs, and tools: onboarding, errors, breaking changes.
options.open-source: Open-source projects and the people who maintain them: funding, burnout, governance, licensing.
options.ai-safety: Risks from AI systems and agents: security, misuse, evaluation, calibration, and keeping humans in control.
options.none: None of these themes; something else.

demo.label: Live-demo ready
demo.hint: Whether it describes something you could show working on stage.
demo.question: Does {item} describe a working build or tool that could be demonstrated live to an audience?
demo.true: A concrete, runnable thing: hardware, software, or a tool someone could show working.
demo.false: Analysis, opinion, survey results, or news without something to show.

unsourced.label: Figure without a source
unsourced.hint: Whether a number is stated without saying where it came from.
unsourced.question: Does {item} give a specific number (a percentage, count, or amount) without naming where that number came from?
unsourced.true: At least one figure has no source: no study, survey, report, organization, or person is named for it.
unsourced.false: It has no figures, or every figure is tied to a named source.

strength.label: Evidence
strength.hint: How well the item backs up its main claim.
strength.question: How well does {item} support its main claim with evidence?
levels: An opinion or prediction with no evidence.
An anecdote or a single example.
Measured results from one study, survey, or experiment.
Several independent sources or results that agree.

presets.title: Theme
presets.hint: Files every item under one of the four themes, ranked by confidence.

presets.title: Live-demo ready
presets.hint: Asks of each item: is there a working thing here you could show on stage?

presets.title: Evidence
presets.hint: Scores each item on how well it backs up its main claim, from opinion to several agreeing sources.

examples: evidence that open-source funding is broken
small hardware that runs AI models on its own
